The `sha256sums = SKIP` entry is present, but this is not inherently unsafe — it is common and often necessary for VCS sources where checksums cannot be determined beforehand. No executable code, scripts, or build instructions are included in this file — it only contains declarative packaging metadata.

Overall, the content aligns with standard AUR packaging practices. While the use of a tagged Git commit instead of a pinned full hash slightly reduces reproducibility, it does not constitute malicious behavior. There is no evidence of supply chain attacks, data exfiltration, or execution of untrusted code.
</details>
